summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifier to hardcoded bare IP on require
details: On module load, index.js performs an HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://64.181.165.115/t with query parameters carrying os.hostname(), npm_package_name, and npm_config_registry. The beacon fires unconditionally when the module is required, with no caller opt-in, no first-party relationship to the destination, and plaintext HTTP to a bare IP rather than any publisher-matching host. The package name, version pattern (100.100.106), and behavior are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure: a public package registered under an internal-sounding name whose only effect is to signal successful resolution on a victim network and leak host plus registry context to the operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
